note: Rule 5 applied strictly: no evidence of actual supplies found in either direction of trade. The single customs row is an IMPORT of a machine-tool/measuring item (HS 90318000, B/L 7524533, dated 2024-02-14, Moscow -> Bangalore Air) from OOO VOLGA-AVTOMATIKA, not an export shipment by the Indian company. Declared HS 853650 (electrical switches/connectors) does not match the only observed record's HS 90318000 — per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the factual code should be recorded as 90318000 for the observed transaction, with the declared 853650 flagged as unconfirmed. Registered address on the customs record: "H.NO.1051 MADLEM BHAT NEAR RASHTROLI TEMPLE" (Goa), consistent with the 'Goabay' name; a second address line "KANUNNIKOVA STREET 6/1-17, VOLGOGRAD 400001" appears in the buyer block and is the Russian counterparty's address, not the Indian entity's. Revenue and export volume: null — no public figures found, not estimated. Role assessment: single import transaction with no visible domestic turnover or export activity is consistent with a trader/unknown profile rather than a manufacturer; no rejection grounds (entity appears active in 2024 customs data, not shown liquidated). Caveat: only one free-tier aggregator (ImportKey) was readable; Volza/Eximpedia/Trademo were blocked (403) and the search engine was unavailable, so this is a single-source finding and a paid-database re-check is advisable before final classification.
